name: Kenyan employment contract
description: A contract of employment between an employer and an employee in Kenya: job title, salary, working hours, leave, probation, termination and similar terms
example_questions: How much notice do I have to give?

summary_fields.name: employer_and_employee
summary_fields.label: Employer and employee
summary_fields.description: Who the employer and the employee are

summary_fields.name: start_date_and_term
summary_fields.label: Start date and term
summary_fields.description: When employment starts, and whether it is permanent or for a fixed term

summary_fields.name: probation
summary_fields.label: Probation
summary_fields.description: Length and terms of any probation period

summary_fields.name: salary
summary_fields.label: Salary
summary_fields.description: Pay amount, frequency, and any allowances or benefits

summary_fields.name: working_hours
summary_fields.label: Working hours
summary_fields.description: Normal hours and days of work, and how overtime is handled

summary_fields.name: leave
summary_fields.label: Leave
summary_fields.description: Annual, sick, maternity, paternity and any other leave stated

summary_fields.name: notice_period
summary_fields.label: Notice period
summary_fields.description: Notice either side must give to end the contract

summary_fields.name: your_obligations
summary_fields.label: Your obligations
summary_fields.description: Main things the employee must do or must not do

risk_categories.label: Probation terms
risk_categories.description: Long, extendable or one-sided probation, or termination during probation without notice

risk_categories.label: Notice and termination
risk_categories.description: Short notice, termination at the employer's discretion, or dismissal without a hearing

risk_categories.label: Non-compete / confidentiality after leaving
risk_categories.description: Restrictions on where or for whom the employee can work, or what they can disclose, after the job ends

risk_categories.label: Pay deductions
risk_categories.description: The employer can deduct from or set off against salary, especially at its own discretion

risk_categories.label: Unpaid or open-ended overtime
risk_categories.description: Extra hours required without extra pay, or no limit on working hours

risk_categories.label: Transfer or relocation
risk_categories.description: The employer can move the employee to another place or role, especially at the employee's cost

risk_categories.label: Employer changes terms alone
risk_categories.description: The employer can change the contract without the employee's agreement

risk_categories.label: Ownership of your work
risk_categories.description: The employer claims ownership of the employee's work or inventions, especially outside working hours
